name: chopped-choir-sample-riddim
style: bedroom grime instrumental 140 bpm built around a sampled children's choir, found sound from a crackly 1950s school assembly record, kids' voices pitched up a semitone and sliced into chops, prim old-fashioned English diction, tinny mono and far away, raw square-wave sub stabs, cheap string-preset stab that stutters, dry eski clicks on the off-beat, clap on two and four, reload rewind spinback and gunshot hit as percussion, beat cuts out leaving only the dusty choir loop, cold sparse dystopian
exclude: piano, organ, adult vocals, rap, MC, spoken word, autotune, solo singer, live band, warm pads
lyrics:
[Intro: vinyl crackle, choir sample alone, chopped]

[Verse: riddim drops in, square bass stabs, string stab stutters, each line end cut short by the chop]
We can't afford a bed for you,
The purse is far too thin;

[Break: everything drops out except the scratchy choir sample]
There is room on all those islands,

[Rewind spinback, gunshot hit, riddim slams back]
But you will sleep in a bin.

[End: hard stop, silence]
